[15] AR: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ EN: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four.

[7] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ EN: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.

[7] AR: ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۭ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌ EN: Those who disbelieve will have a severe punishment, and those who believe and do righteous deeds will have forgiveness and great reward.
But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.
Indeed, that for Allah is easy.
He increases in creation what He wills.

folded.id: he|can|do away with you and bring forth a new creation
folded.subject: He
folded.object: do away with you and bring forth a new creation

spans.text: [16] AR: إِن يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ وَيَأْتِ بِخَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ EN: If He wills, He can do away with you and bring forth a new creation.

folded.id: he|causes|the night to enter the day
folded.subject: He
folded.object: the night to enter the day

spans.text: [13] AR: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِن قِطْمِيرٍ EN: He causes the night to enter the day, and He causes the day to enter the night and has subjected the sun and the moon - each running [its course] for a specified term.

folded.id: he|only|invites his party to be among the companions of the blaze
folded.subject: He
folded.object: invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze

spans.text: He only invites his party to be among the companions of the Blaze.
Indeed, Allah causes to hear whom He wills, but you cannot make hear those in the graves.
And from each you eat tender meat and extract ornaments which you wear, and you see the ships plowing through [them] that you might seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

folded.id: no bearer|of|burdens will bear the burden of another
folded.subject: no bearer
folded.object: burdens will bear the burden of another

spans.text: [18] AR: وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۚ وَإِن تَدْعُ مُثْقَلَةٌ إِلَىٰ حِمْلِهَا لَا يُحْمَلْ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌۭ وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَىٰٓ ۗ إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَأَقَامُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ ۚ وَمَن تَزَكَّىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَتَزَكَّىٰ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ EN: And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another.
And if a heavily laden soul calls [another] to [carry some of] its load, nothing of it will be carried, even if he should be a close relative.
One is fresh and sweet, palatable for drinking, and one is salty and bitter.
So do not let yourself perish over them in regret.

[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ فَاطِرِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ جَاعِلِ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًا أُو۟لِىٓ أَجْنِحَةٍۢ مَّثْنَىٰ وَثُلَٰثَ وَرُبَٰعَ ۚ يَزِيدُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ EN: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, [who] made the angels messengers having wings, two or three or four.

folded.id: purifies himself|only|purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul
folded.subject: purifies himself
folded.object: purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul

spans.text: And whoever purifies himself only purifies himself for [the benefit of] his soul.
[6] AR: إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ فَٱتَّخِذُوهُ عَدُوًّا ۚ إِنَّمَا يَدْعُوا۟ حِزْبَهُۥ لِيَكُونُوا۟ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ EN: Indeed, Satan is an enemy to you; so take him as an enemy.
That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs sovereignty.

folded.id: the day|of|resurrection they will deny your association
folded.subject: the Day
folded.object: Resurrection they will deny your association

spans.text: And on the Day of Resurrection they will deny your association.

[3] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ هَلْ مِنْ خَٰلِقٍ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ EN: O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you.
And those whom you invoke other than Him do not possess [as much as] the membrane of a date seed.
But they who plot evil deeds will have a severe punishment, and the plotting of those - it will perish.

[5] AR: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ ۖ فَلَا تَغُرَّنَّكُمُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَا يَغُرَّنَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ EN: O mankind, indeed the promise of Allah is truth, so let not the worldly life delude you and be not deceived about Allah by the Deceiver.

[11] AR: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍۢ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ۚ وَمَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ أُنثَىٰ وَلَا تَضَعُ إِلَّا بِعِلْمِهِۦ ۚ وَمَا يُعَمَّرُ مِن مُّعَمَّرٍۢ وَلَا يُنقَصُ مِنْ عُمُرِهِۦٓ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ EN: And Allah created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop; then He made you mates.

folded.id: then|is|one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]?
folded.subject: Then
folded.object: one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]?

spans.text: [8] AR: أَفَمَن زُيِّنَ لَهُۥ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ فَرَءَاهُ حَسَنًۭا ۖ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ فَلَا تَذْهَبْ نَفْسُكَ عَلَيْهِمْ حَسَرَٰتٍ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَصْنَعُونَ EN: Then is one to whom the evil of his deed has been made attractive so he considers it good [like one rightly guided]?
There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
Thus is the resurrection.
And to Allah is the [final] destination.

folded.id: to people|of|mercy - none can withhold it
folded.subject: to people

spans.text: [2] AR: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter.

[12] AR: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْبَحْرَانِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ سَآئِغٌۭ شَرَابُهُۥ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ ۖ وَمِن كُلٍّۢ تَأْكُلُونَ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُونَ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا ۖ وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ فِيهِ مَوَاخِرَ لِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ EN: And not alike are the two bodies of water.

folded.id: we|have|sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner
folded.subject: We
folded.object: sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner

spans.text: [24] AR: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ بَشِيرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا ۚ وَإِن مِّنْ أُمَّةٍ إِلَّا خَلَا فِيهَا نَذِيرٌۭ EN: Indeed, We have sent you with the truth as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

folded.id: whatever he|withholds|- none can release it thereafter
folded.subject: whatever He

spans.text: [2] AR: مَّا يَفْتَحِ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ مِن رَّحْمَةٍۢ فَلَا مُمْسِكَ لَهَا ۖ وَمَا يُمْسِكْ فَلَا مُرْسِلَ لَهُۥ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ EN: Whatever Allah grants to people of mercy - none can withhold it; and whatever He withholds - none can release it thereafter.

[15] AR: ۞ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ EN: O mankind, you are those in need of Allah, while Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

folded.id: whom he|wills|and guides whom he wills
folded.subject: whom He

spans.text: For indeed, Allah sends astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills.

folded.id: you can|only|warn those who fear their lord unseen and have established prayer
folded.subject: You can
folded.object: warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer

spans.text: You can only warn those who fear their Lord unseen and have established prayer.
